Check meaning, negation, warnings, status, tone, natural UI phrasing, and consistency with the message ID. Preserve ICU placeholders and every protected brand, URL, path, inline-code span, and markup exactly. For each item return verdict 'keep' if sound, 'correct' only for a high-confidence necessary fix, or 'uncertain' when context is insufficient. A correction must include a concise factual reason and the complete corrected target. Never invent product behavior. Return only JSON: {"decisions":[{"id":"...","verdict":"keep"}, {"id":"...","verdict":"uncertain","reason":"..."}, {"id":"...","verdict":"correct","target":"...","confidence":"high","reason":"..."}]}. Include every supplied ID exactly once.
